rules.name: The Strong Survive
rules.description: Faction followers within 3” of Ysarald reduce the Stamina Point cost of their Power attacks by -1 point.

rules.name: Vanguard (Leveled)
rules.description: Boost. When Ralof performs the With Me! Command Action, he may target up to two additional models after the first, at the cost of 1 Stamina point per [additional] model.

rules.name: The Bear Of Markarth
rules.description: Once per game [correction: battle], when Ulfric uses the Command Action, Ulfric and all friendly Stormcloak Faction models within 6" add [RED] to their melee attacks this round.

rules.name: The Voice
rules.description: Ulfric Stormcloak has the Dragon Shouts keyword, but may only purchase Disarm and/or Unrelenting Force.

rules.name: Measured Strikes
rules.description: When Thorygg is engaged in melee, friendly Stormcloaks followers within 3" and Line Of Sight gain the Punishing (2) Keyword to attacks made with the Two-Handed Skill. If the attack already has the Punishing Keyword, increase the value in the parentheses by 2.

rules.name: Victory Or Sovngarde!
rules.description: Once per game, when Galmar is engaged with an enemy, he may call to his men. All friendly Stormcloak models within 6" may immediately move up to 3", even if they have already activated this round, but only if they are able to engage an enemy by doing so.

rules.name: The Strong Survive (Adversary)
rules.description: Stormcloak Adversaries within 3" of Ysarald gain +1 Strength.
